text:
**Best pick for most people: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25W.** It's the best value among the 25W stands in these results, and it has a fan for cooling.

- **Price:** $99.99 at ESR's US store. The Dealectric listing says code PARTNER18 took $17.99 off when tested on 2026-10-23, which would bring it to about $82. Checkout is the final word on the price. [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)
- **Buy:** [ESR CryoBoost via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission if you buy.
- **Caveat:** 25W only works on iPhone 17 series, iPhone 16 Pro Max, and iPhone 16 Plus. iPhone Air, 16, and 16 Pro get 20W, and older iPhones get 15W. [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)
- **Reviews:** WIRED calls it the fastest 3-in-1 travel charger and notes that its fan has an off button for quiet nights. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

**Other options**

- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W ($129.99):** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested, and it still folds for travel. It weighs 399g, so it's better as a desk stand than a travel charger. I don't have a verified buy link for it. [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **Nomad Stand One Max ($169):** 25W for the iPhone, with a pad that angles for portrait or landscape. No power adapter is included, so you need a 40W one. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Nimble Podium 3-in-1 ($130):** 25W, and its pads can lie flat for nightstand use. The Apple Watch charges slowly, so it's best left overnight. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand (about $90–$109):** WIRED's "Best Overall." It charges the iPhone at 15W, not 25W, but it's a strong all-around choice. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **ESR Qi2 3-in-1 (about $40 on sale, normally $80):** The cheapest Qi2 3-in-1 WIRED tested. It charges at 15W, and its Apple Watch charger is a separate unit. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Which to choose**

- **iPhone 17, 16 Pro Max, or 16 Plus, and you want speed:** ESR CryoBoost.
- **You want a tall desk stand and don't mind the price:** Satechi.
- **You're on an older iPhone, or you charge overnight:** 25W won't make much difference, so the cheaper 15W Belkin or ESR is fine.

Before you buy, confirm that your AirPods case supports wireless charging. Only wireless cases work on these stands.
